<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1C1E21"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="27" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">9:41</text>
    <rect x="326" y="18" width="3" height="6" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="331" y="16" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="336" y="14" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <rect x="341" y="12" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
    <circle cx="355" cy="20" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="355" y1="20" x2="358" y2="17" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="367" y="14" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="16" width="14" height="7" rx="2" fill="#34EAB9"/>
    <rect x="387" y="17" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#E4E6EB"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,72 20,80 28,88" fill="none" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="21" y1="80" x2="38" y2="80" stroke="#E4E6EB" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="86" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Set up your profile</text>
    <text x="195" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Tell the community a little about yourself</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile photo -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="174" r="57" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="170" r="55" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="154" r="16" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="190" rx="27" ry="18" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <circle cx="235" cy="207" r="20" fill="#1877F2" stroke="#1C1E21" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="235" y1="200" x2="235" y2="214" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="228" y1="207" x2="242" y2="207" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="244" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Add profile photo</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Form fields -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="276" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Username</text>
    <rect x="24" y="284" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="314" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">@maya.carter</text>
    
    <text x="24" y="356" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Full name</text>
    <rect x="24" y="364" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="394" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Maya Carter</text>
    
    <text x="24" y="436" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Email address</text>
    <rect x="24" y="444" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="474" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">maya.carter@email.com</text>
    
    <text x="24" y="516" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">Phone number</text>
    <rect x="24" y="524" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#3A3B3C" stroke="#50545B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="38" y="554" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">+1 415 555 0187</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="604" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.18"/>
    <rect x="24" y="602" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="633" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Next</text>
    <text x="195" y="681" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Step 2 of 3</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="748" width="390" height="96" fill="#25272A"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="748" x2="390" y2="748" stroke="#3A3B3C" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="44" cy="775" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="775" x2="49" y2="770" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="44" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Explore</text>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="116,772 128,762 140,772" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="120" y="772" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="128" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Home</text>
    
    <!-- Saved -->
    <polyline points="202,763 216,763 216,785 209,780 202,785 202,763" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="209" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Saved</text>
    
    <!-- Profile active -->
    <circle cx="282" cy="769" r="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <ellipse cx="282" cy="783" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="282" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Profile</text>
    
    <!-- Notifications -->
    <circle cx="351" cy="765" r="3" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <rect x="344" y="769" width="14" height="13" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#B0B3B8" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="351" cy="784" r="2" fill="#B0B3B8"/>
    <text x="351" y="809" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#B0B3B8">Alerts</text>
  </g>
</svg>
